program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g))
                  (centers (for*/list ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1)))
                               #:when
                               (and
                                 (= (at g r c) 4)
                                 (let ((up (at g (- r 1) c))
                                       (dn (at g (+ r 1) c))
                                       (lt (at g r (- c 1)))
                                       (rt (at g r (+ c 1))))
                                   (and
                                     (!= up 0)
                                     (!= up bg)
                                     (= up dn)
                                     (= up lt)
                                     (= up rt)))))
                             (at g (- r 1) c)))
                  (best-color (let ((freq (make-hash))
                                    (best 0)
                                    (best-count -1))
                                (for ((col centers))
                                  (hash-set! freq col (+ 1 (hash-ref freq col 0))))
                                (hash-for-each freq
                                               (lambda (k v)
                                                 (when
                                                   (> v best-count)
                                                   (set! best k)
                                                   (set! best-count v))))
                                best)))
             (build-grid 1 1 (r c) best-color)))))
